## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behaviour.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] `npm run licenses:check` passes.
- [ ] Tarball consumers or examples were updated when the public contract changed.
- [ ] Bundle-size changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation and types match the implementation.

## Privacy and licenses

- [ ] Local transformations make no unexpected network requests.
- [ ] New dependencies and transitive licenses were reviewed.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or internal product strategy is included.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for interface changes, or write “Not applicable”.
